title: The Distant Horizon
author: Vesper Ashgrove
blurb: Xanthe Eriksen, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
